title: Consolidate post-rollout actions: safety playbook, pre-checks, and rollback hysteresis
creator: Aisha Gomez
description: After the 2026-03-02 canary that experienced a high false-positive rerank and latency spike for prod-ver-3, this ticket consolidates all post-rollout follow-ups into actionable engineering work and operational artifacts. Deliverables: 1) a single operational safety playbook documenting pre-rollout automated checks (golden-set scoring, latency tail, token-level QA), manual escalation paths, and post-failure triage steps; 2) implement a shadow-to-canary divergence detector that computes distribution drift on generated tokens and semantic score regressions; 3) add hysteresis and dampening to the auto-rollback engine (avoid oscillation on noisy signals) and expose safe override flags; 4) integrate Canary telemetry hooks into Console dashboards with per-route signal breakdowns and an alerting policy; 5) publish a concise postmortem summary with prioritized follow-ups and owners.
comments: 2026-03-05 - Aisha G: Created ticket after the prod-ver-3 canary failure. Initial list of artifacts pulled from incident retro notes and Ops channel.

2026-03-06 - Liam C: Spike complete for divergence detector design. Proposal: lightweight embedding-based distance + token-level KL on top-k logits. Draft in drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/divergence-design.
2026-03-07 - PM review (Ravi P): Asked to prioritise customer-visible signals (answer correctness + latency p99) over proxy metrics. Added to labels.

2026-03-08 - Eng review: Decision to implement hysteresis with two-window smoothing (5m short, 30m long) and require both windows to breach thresholds before rollback. Trade-off: slightly higher detection latency vs stability.
2026-03-10 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 - adds divergence detector and telemetry hooks. Needs QA and perf run on staging.
2026-03-11 - Ops note (Maya S): Runbook draft linked: https://confluence.redwood/workflow/safety-playbook - added manual rollback steps, contact list, and postmortem template.
2026-03-12 - Liam C: Running load test for telemetry at 80qps on staging; observed 1.7% overhead on tail latency with hooks enabled. Working on sampling to reduce overhead.
2026-03-12 - Security (Anil K): No additional security review required for these changes; logging PII review complete.
2026-03-12 - Next: finalize thresholds, merge PR behind feature flag, schedule canary window with on-call and SRE present.
acceptance_criteria: Safety playbook available in Confluence and linked from Console
Divergence detector running in staging for 2 days with false-positive rate < 2% on historical traffic
Auto-rollback requires dual-window breach and operator confirmation when customer_impact is high
Telemetry shows <1% added p99 overhead in production sampling mode
Postmortem and prioritized action list assigned with owners
